table "app"."items" -- items with everything

Columns
#  | Field     | Type                     | Null | Key | Default                                   | Extra                                               | Comment
---+-----------+--------------------------+------+-----+-------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------+--------------
 1 | id        | bigint                   | NO   | PRI |                                           | GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY                        | surrogate key
 2 | seq_no    | integer                  | NO   |     | nextval('app.items_seq_no_seq'::regclass) | auto_increment                                      |
 3 | code      | character varying(20)    | NO   | MUL |                                           |                                                     |
 4 | region    | character(2)             | NO   |     | 'EU'                                      |                                                     |
 5 | name      | text                     | NO   |     |                                           |                                                     |
 6 | note      | character varying(40)    | YES  |     | 'NULL'                                    |                                                     |
 7 | nothing   | character varying(40)    | YES  |     | NULL                                      |                                                     |
 8 | quote_str | character varying(10)    | NO   |     | 'it''s'                                   |                                                     |
 9 | price     | numeric(10,2)            | NO   |     | 0.00                                      |                                                     |
10 | qty       | integer                  | NO   |     | 1                                         |                                                     |
11 | ratio     | double precision         | YES  |     | -1.5                                      |                                                     |
12 | total     | numeric(12,2)            | YES  |     |                                           | GENERATED ALWAYS AS (price * (qty)::numeric) STORED |
13 | status    | app.status               | NO   |     | 'new'                                     |                                                     |
14 | tags      | text[]                   | YES  |     | NULL                                      |                                                     |
15 | doc       | jsonb                    | YES  |     | NULL                                      |                                                     |
16 | bin       | bytea                    | YES  |     | NULL                                      |                                                     |
17 | uid       | uuid                     | NO   | UNI | gen_random_uuid()                         |                                                     |
18 | ticket    | integer                  | YES  |     | nextval('app.ticket_seq'::regclass)       |                                                     |
19 | created   | timestamp with time zone | NO   |     | now()                                     |                                                     |
20 | day       | date                     | YES  |     | NULL                                      |                                                     |
21 | small     | smallint                 | YES  |     | NULL                                      |                                                     |
22 | parent_a  | integer                  | YES  |     | NULL                                      |                                                     |
23 | parent_b  | character varying(20)    | YES  |     | NULL                                      |                                                     |

Primary and unique keys
Key         | Name           | Columns
------------+----------------+-------------
PRIMARY KEY | items_pkey     | id
UNIQUE      | uq_code_region | code, region
UNIQUE      | uq_items_uid   | uid

Foreign keys
Name      | Columns            | References            | On update | On delete
----------+--------------------+-----------------------+-----------+----------
fk_parent | parent_a, parent_b | "app"."parent" (a, b) | RESTRICT  | CASCADE

Check constraints
Name     | Expression                                         | Enforced
---------+----------------------------------------------------+---------
chk_code | code::text <> ''::text AND code::text !~ ';'::text | YES
chk_qty  | qty > 0 AND qty < 100000                           | YES

Indexes
Name                | Columns                    | Include | Filter                        | Unique | Type  | Visible | Comment
--------------------+----------------------------+---------+-------------------------------+--------+-------+---------+--------
items_pkey          | id                         |         |                               | YES    | btree | YES     |
ix_items_active     | code varchar_pattern_ops   | qty     | status = 'active'::app.status | NO     | btree | YES     |
ix_items_doc        | doc jsonb_path_ops         |         |                               | NO     | gin   | YES     |
ix_items_lower_name | (lower(name))              |         |                               | NO     | btree | YES     |
ix_items_price_desc | price DESC NULLS LAST, qty |         |                               | NO     | btree | YES     |
uq_code_region      | code, region               |         |                               | YES    | btree | YES     |
uq_items_uid        | uid                        |         |                               | YES    | btree | YES     |

Triggers
Name            | Timing | Event
----------------+--------+---------------------------------------------------------
trg_items_bi    | BEFORE | INSERT OR UPDATE OF note FOR EACH ROW WHEN (new.qty > 0)
trg_items_trunc | AFTER  | TRUNCATE FOR EACH STATEMENT (disabled)

Table options
Option        | Value
--------------+----------------------
access_method | heap
owner         | postgres
comment       | items with everything
